reason: E2 directly supports that cryo-rolling and annealing of a brittle intermetallic-containing HEA produces a heterogeneous microstructure with enhanced strength-ductility synergy, supporting the first two premises. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that such processing preserves caloric phase transformations, nor do they involve the specific MnNiSi-FeCoGe alloy; these premises remain unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: Cryogenic rolling followed by annealing can create a heterogeneous, hierarchical lamellar architecture in HEAs
Such a heterogeneous microstructure enhances strength-ductility synergy and reduces cracking
Microstructural refinement via this process does not alter the intrinsic caloric phase transformation
The proposed treatment is applicable to the specific (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 alloy system
